(p.8); not isolated under S5(3)/HO11 because of the farmhouse and a group of dwellings 100m away (p.9). (p.9), using the applicant's trip rates, "about 4.4 two-way vehicle trips per dwelling between 07:00 and 19:00, or about 57 trips" (p.9), along "a private drive and a narrow rural lane" (p.9). (p.9); conclusion "This conflicts with the AS. 10 principles of making provision for sustainable transport and with NPPF policy TR3(1)(a)." (p.9), weighted moderate because the IPPS treats CS.15/CS.16 as out of date. (p.11); GB7(1)(e) excluded as "Agricultural buildings are excluded from the definition of previously developed land" (p.11) without citing Annex B (grep 0 hits); GB7(1)(g) tested on TR3 and GB8 (p.11); very special circumstances balance (p.18-19), then S5(5) and S5(2) run "For completeness, had the development not been inappropriate" (p.19). (p.6), held physically well-related to Little Kineton (p.6); S5(1)(j) found complied with and the S5(5)-style balance run with S5(2) quoted (p.17).
